steps.observation: Work on this for 30 seconds; do not stop early. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
Here are three effective strategies for cutting urban carbon emissions:

1. Expand and Improve Low-Carbon Transport  
   • Invest in high-capacity public transit (light rail, BRT, clean buses)  
   • Build safe, connected walking and cycling networks  
   • Implement congestion pricing or low-emission zones to discourage private car use  

2. Boost Building Energy Efficiency  
   • Enforce strict efficiency standards for new construction  
   • Retrofit existing buildings with better insulation, efficient windows, and smart HVAC controls  
   • Encourage on-site renewables (solar panels) and green roofs to reduce heating/cooling loads  

3. Transition to Clean Energy and Electrification  
   • Deploy city-scale solar, wind, or district geothermal systems  
   • Electrify municipal vehicle fleets (buses, waste trucks, service vehicles) and provide public charging infrastructure  
   • Partner with utilities to develop smart grids and time-of-use pricing that favor renewable supply over fossil fuels
